stem: Which views were argued by either Alexander Hamilton or Thomas Jefferson while debating the establishment of a national bank? Move the correct answer to each box in the chart.

options.text: The Constitution does not give the government the power to set up a national bank.
A national bank would help maintain public credit.
A national bank would favor manufacturing at the expense of agriculture.
Holding public funds and paying government debts requires a national bank.
